# shash.builds: Shashwat Jain, web designer

> Shashwat Jain designs and builds one-page websites for US service businesses (coaches, consultants, realtors, therapists, dentists, lawyers, cleaners, contractors, salons, gyms, photographers, accountants). Each site has one job: get the visitor to book a call or appointment. Flat price $400, live in 7 days, 2 rounds of changes, booking built in, the client owns the site. He works US hours, 8:30 am to 6:30 pm Eastern, from India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shashwat-websites.netlify.app/): the offer, sample designs, how a project runs and how to book a call.
- [Lookbook](https://shashwat-websites.netlify.app/lookbook.html): try 8 website styles on your own business with your own name and photos, live in the browser.
- [Free Claude skills](https://shashwat-websites.netlify.app/skills.html): "Booked one-pager", a free Claude skill for building one-page sites that get bookings.

## How a project runs

- Day 1: a 15-minute call about the business, the customer and the one action the page must drive.
- Day 3: a first draft link to open on a phone.
- Day 7: live on the client's domain, booking tested end to end.
